facts.logging: Every request and result is stored for ten years.
facts.transparency_notice: The dealer form says an automated assessment is used.

gold.rationale: Assesses whether walk-in individuals can get car ijarah and for how much: creditworthiness of natural persons, Annex III 5(b).
